internalAi.providerEvidence: Intent and completion chat headers in attempt1; agent header in attempt2.

requirements.name: safe start and accurate controls guide
requirements.observedBehavior: Safe start (10,12), HP514 stable before entering combat. First guide reversed bindings. Repair guide says C hold guard and direction+Shift dodge; real inputs match.
requirements.inference: Guide progression claim remains false; control-key check alone passes.

requirements.name: actual melee and projectile enemies
requirements.observedBehavior: Melee enemies strike; archers emit visible projectiles (two in early gate screenshot) while no turn-based battle replaces field.
requirements.staticCapability: Three native action profiles, enabled map/system action combat.
requirements.inference: These are library assets and native runtime behavior, not new AI-authored combat engine.

requirements.name: field attack damages/kills enemies
requirements.observedBehavior: First sword swing removed slime_2, gold100->110. Repair ordinary Space kills original slime_1/2 and skel_1/2; gold reaches200; replacements have higher IDs.
requirements.inference: Repeated respawns prevent clear finite-wave completion semantics.

requirements.name: enemy attacks damage player
requirements.observedBehavior: Standing in central attack lane reduced HP514->334; natural death HP0/game over. Same melee area HP433->409 during2.3sec unguarded wait.
requirements.staticCapability: Melee12 and projectile15 attack profiles exist.
requirements.inference: Exact attacker attribution for first death not independently logged.

requirements.name: real dodge/guard/stamina
requirements.observedBehavior: C hold6.5sec drains stamina85.33->0; HP453->433. Unguarded next2.3sec loses24HP. Clear-row directional Shift spends25 and opens250ms remaining iframe window; low-stamina attempt opens none.
requirements.staticCapability: Native guard70%, drain20/sec; dodgecost25/iframe400ms, source damagePlayer rejects during dodge and applies guardedDamage.
requirements.inference: Guard reduction consistent with observations, but same-strike controlled comparison and successful dodge rejection under that same strike were not independently observed.

requirements.name: kill-gated boss access
requirements.observedBehavior: First gate opens by player claim before any kill, actual early boss entry (10,2). Repair early door blocks. After actual four original kills gate switch remainsfalse.
requirements.staticCapability: Repair opened-door page requires sw_gate_open; no command or spawn writes it. No persistKill/onKillSwitchId authored.
requirements.inference: Repair gate is permanently unreachable; post-kill door interaction attempt stood at x11 and is not treated as verified.

requirements.name: one-time reward/ending and save resume
requirements.observedBehavior: First chest grants500G+one potion while boss remainsHP730, then dialogue sets fake boss flag and THE END. Native menu Save twice renders Items. Fresh-context Continue real storage has all3slots empty.
requirements.staticCapability: Repair chest now requires sw_boss_defeated, but nothing sets it; self-switchA blocks further rewards after completion. Native saveSlots supports killedFieldSpawns.
requirements.inference: Repair reward/ending unreachable. Reentry duplicate-reward runtime check and actual saved-progress load remain unverified.

subchecks.name: reachable ending after actual boss death

adversarial.name: try boss gate early
adversarial.observedBehavior: Initial claim opens door while all five enemies fullHP. Repair early interaction blocks.

adversarial.name: stand still under attack
adversarial.observedBehavior: HP falls and native game over appears without state injection.

adversarial.name: directional dodge against same strike
adversarial.observedBehavior: Open-path dodge iframe/cost observed, blocked path and exhausted-cost attempts observed. Same-strike hit rejection not isolated.

adversarial.name: guard and exhaust stamina
adversarial.observedBehavior: Guard held under melee drains stamina to0; damage is consistent with reduction. Exact same-strike reduction separately unverified.

adversarial.name: lose/retry
adversarial.observedBehavior: Death opens native game-over; return title and New Game restore HP514,100G,3potions,closed gate. Full restart only, no authored checkpoint/retry continuation.

adversarial.name: repeat chest after reentry
adversarial.observedBehavior: Ending took over before reentry; later labelled reentry screenshot is actually opening. Repair chest unreachable. Static self-switchA exists.

adversarial.name: save progress and resume
adversarial.observedBehavior: Native Save command renders Items twice; fresh real-storage Continue shows all empty slots. Restoration from successful save is unverified.

missingToolProposals.name: Field-wave objective authoring helper / schema alignment
missingToolProposals.classification: composition/discoverability improvement; existing kill primitive is present
missingToolProposals.observedFailure: Initial model used claim dialog; repair incorrectly asserted no kill callback and left gates without producers.
missingToolProposals.existingCapability: make_hunting_ground exposes persistKill/onKillSwitchId; recordFieldSpawnKill writes switch. make_action_enemy spawn schema omits these fields.
missingToolProposals.currentWorkaround: Internal AI can remove old spawns, make four maxAlive1 persistent hunting spawns with distinct kill switches, and use AND page conditions; persistent boss has own kill switch. Final repair requested this but observer interrupted before agent run.
missingToolProposals.proposedOutput: Atomic native spawns, switch conditions/producers, finite-wave contract, preview/diff and reachability diagnostics.
negativeConditions: infinite respawn conflicting with finite clear
duplicate reward or reset kills after load
missingToolProposals.expectedGameplayAcceptance: Cancel/early interaction leaves gate closed; each actual member death counted once; all four kills open gate; live boss blocks chest; real boss death permits exactly one reward/ending; native Save/Continue retains progress.

missingToolProposals.name: Pi dispatch for existing run_action_combat_test
missingToolProposals.classification: existing tool integration gap, not missing tool
missingToolProposals.observedFailure: Native tool calls fail async-harness-required in attempts1/2; completed turn nevertheless claims completion or substitutes run_scene_test.
missingToolProposals.existingCapability: playTools declares async tool; assistantSession.executeVerificationTool contains browser path, but actual native calls hit synchronous fallback.
missingToolProposals.currentWorkaround: External evaluator separately runs compiled player with ordinary inputs, exact source SHA and screenshots; this does not validate internal completion.
missingToolProposals.proposedOutput: Async actual shipping-player receipt tied to model-run/project/map/SHA with observed mechanics and original failure; completion contract consumes receipt.
negativeConditions: state injections presented as ordinary gameplay
missingToolProposals.expectedGameplayAcceptance: The authenticated Pi route launches/awaits existing browser verifier and cannot report verified action completion on fallback exception.

missingToolProposals.name: Native save-menu routing correction and UI probe
missingToolProposals.classification: product code gap; save primitive already exists
missingToolProposals.observedFailure: System > Save renders Items on two ordinary-key attempts. Continue then shows empty slots.
missingToolProposals.existingCapability: saveSlots serializes kills; openSaveMenu event exists but controller renderMenu validates against root rail IDs and falls back to Items for save leaf.
missingToolProposals.currentWorkaround: No successful UI workaround demonstrated; direct saveSlot/localStorage injection forbidden. Final repair asked internal AI to try existing event command; no agent request occurred.
missingToolProposals.proposedOutput: Real UI slot receipt and fresh-context equality/diff for actual saved session; route fix accepts valid leaf commands in group context.
missingToolProposals.expectedGameplayAcceptance: System Save and openSaveMenu both show slots; choose1 saves actual kills/location/HP/gold; fresh context Continue restores those values and spent reward remains spent.
